package.name: ByeTunes
package.shortDescription: Downloads, lyrics & tools for Apple Music.

descriptionlist.description: Make Apple Music your own. ByeTunes adds powerful tools for your library, downloads, lyrics, playlists, and interface on iOS 15 and iOS 16.

DOWNLOAD MUSIC — Save songs, albums, and playlists to your library, with artwork and metadata. Import audio files and folders, or bring in Spotify and Deezer links. A built-in queue lets you pause, resume, retry, and manage downloads.

LYRICS THAT MOVE WITH THE MUSIC — Fetch timed lyrics for songs and your library, edit lyrics yourself, and find lyrics manually. Choose a lyrics source, adjust timing, and open lyrics automatically. Apple Music Sing's vocal slider is available on iOS 16.2 and later.
MAKE YOUR LIBRARY YOURS — Create and manage regular and smart playlists, pin favorite items, fetch metadata and lyrics for a playlist, and keep your library tidy with maintenance tools.
SHAPE THE INTERFACE — Customize the tab bar and search tabs, add a Downloads tab, and tune the playback and library experience from ByeTunes settings.
Designed for Apple Music on iOS 15 and iOS 16. Some library features are unverified on iOS 16.

changelog.change: 1.9.9 — Improved duplicate detection when importing Spotify and Deezer playlists.
